title: Run Off The Bike · 30 mins
notes:
Intensity: Mod. Hard/Steady

Get off your bike and run. Do the first 5 minutes in Z3. Then ease down into Z2 for the remainder. Running off the bike at a higher intensity helps your body get used to transitioning from cycling to race-pace running. By dropping back to Z2 after a short time, you will not risk excess fatigue or injury.
